name: WatchGuard AuthPoint
summary: WatchGuard AuthPoint is a cloud MFA service sold in two tiers, AuthPoint MFA and Total Identity Security. The product page shows no prices, and buying goes through sales or resellers.

evidence.capability: second-factor methods such as app push or hardware keys

facts.text: Both tiers list push, QR and OTP authentication, FIDO2 passkeys and hardware tokens.
A Geokinetics policy compares a user's device location on consecutive logins and can block attempts that do not fit the distance and time limits an operator sets.
Geofence conditions let admins enforce different MFA requirements for different locations.
The Users page lets admins add and edit user accounts and resend the activation email.
External MFA for Microsoft Entra ID is listed, and it requires Entra ID P1 or higher.

plans.name: AuthPoint MFA
plans.notes: No price on the product page

plans.name: Total Identity Security
plans.notes: Adds Dark Web Credential Monitoring. No price on the product page

hiddenCosts: Hardware tokens are presented as a separate product from the two tiers.
